description: This is a Java unit test class for VcapServicesStringParser, testing parsing of VCAP services strings, immutability, and expected configuration retrieval.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringParserTest
classes.description: Unit test class for VcapServicesStringParser, testing parsing, immutability, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by loading a sample VCAP services JSON configuration from resources and setting an environment variable.

methods.name: initUnderTest
methods.description: Initializes the parser instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the parser class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Tests that parsing a null string throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: parseEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that parsing an empty string results in an empty Config object.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that a known VCAP services string is parsed correctly into a Config object with expected content.
